setup.note: Written to a temp file and compiled with the proto compiler via pool_from_proto(path, []); the original test's own temp-directory bookkeeping is not part of the fixture — only the .proto content and the assertions against its compiled pool are.

steps: compile the proto source into a DescriptorPool via pool_from_proto
call services_from_pool(&pool) and find the 'demo.Greeter' service
compute the JSON example for method 'Down' (input_example)
parse that example JSON back into a DynamicMessage via parse_messages(&hello_desc, example, client_streaming=false)
render it back to JSON via messages_to_json(&parsed, as_array=true)
call parse_messages(&hello_desc, "[{}, {}]", client_streaming=false) and expect an error
call parse_messages(&hello_desc, "[{}, {}]", client_streaming=true) and expect 2 parsed messages

cases.notes: The example generator's one-level recursion cap is what makes 'address.next' collapse to {} instead of recursing into Address again (self-referential message).
Every byte array is decimal, unambiguous protobuf wire bytes copied from the original test's own hex literals (0x3A=58, 0x22=34, 0x1A=26, 0x12=18, 0x32=50, 0x0A=10, 'a'=97, 'b'=98).

wire_byte_annotations.encode_1_list_services_empty: field 7 (list_services), wire type 2 (length-delimited): tag = (7<<3)|2 = 0x3A = 58, length 0, no bytes
wire_byte_annotations.encode_2_file_containing_symbol_ab: field 4, wire type 2: tag = (4<<3)|2 = 0x22 = 34, length 2, bytes 'a'=97 'b'=98
wire_byte_annotations.encode_3_file_by_filename_ab: field 3, wire type 2: tag = (3<<3)|2 = 0x1A = 26, length 2, bytes 'a'=97 'b'=98
wire_byte_annotations.decode_input: field 2 (original_request) { field 7: "" } = [0x12,0x02,0x3A,0x00], then field 6 (list_services_response) { field 1 (service) { field 1 (name): "a" } } = [0x32,0x05,0x0A,0x03,0x0A,0x01,'a']
